scope: Implementation review corrections; this does not waive performance guardrails or replace the 68 original criteria.

corrections.observation: Close before readiness rejects the caller, retains no epoch and waits until the owned PID no longer exists. Malformed handshake fields are tested independently with the correct child PID except the PID-negative case.

corrections.pre_fix: Immediate abort dispatched the mutation; second close settled before child exit.
corrections.post_fix: Post-await cancellation/closed fence prevents dispatch; every close caller waits for the shared termination promise.

corrections.observation: Public code_intel returns clean empty graph evidence after deletion of the last source; sources=[] is not a missing-source failure.
838880-byte fixture spans prepared parts; a late/added framework manifest yields the same source-backed route as a fresh complete captured build. Only final application acknowledges durable state.

corrections.boundary: captured resolver metadata and file existence
corrections.pre_fix: A disk-only src/mod.js intercepted an import that should resolve to captured src/mod/index.js and removed the expected call edge.
corrections.post_fix: Captured fileExists has no disk fallback. Expected import/call edges and complete captured graph match a fresh build; metadata mutation/deletion tests and stock filesystem mode remain covered.

corrections.observation: Real web-tree-sitter and oversized CRLF extraction produce UTF-16 code-unit offsets, not UTF-8 byte offsets. The adapter explicitly converts indexed absolute and lexical line-relative offsets; indexed source spans must independently equal native excerpt content.

A valid positive control anchors exact byte 0..1. Missing locations/scope, invalid coordinates/surrogates, absolute paths, file URIs, traversal and outside symlinks are partial/incomplete and cannot return external source bodies. Public rendering uses common captured source bytes with a hash fence, never a live-disk fallback.

Actual controlled LSP error push then fresh [] and error pull then valid [] complete as empty without stale errors. Silent push-only LSP remains unavailable/not_reported. Real TypeScript and Pyright source-span/own-buffer checks pass.

corrections.pre_fix: Editing nested tsconfig.base.json left scopeDigest unchanged because the regex matched literal backslashes.
corrections.post_fix: TypeScript/JavaScript config edits, additions and deletions change or restore the captured policy identity.

corrections.pre_fix: Three CodeGraph local_patches entries recorded an intermediate patched blob as original_blob, and src/index.ts recorded a stale resulting_blob.
corrections.post_fix: Originals restored from the pinned checkout (93be4835, 7b4bccc1, 90397c55); resulting blobs recomputed from the actual trees.

corrections.pre_fix: added_files exempted paths from drift detection and added_files_sha256 was never read, so an added file could change silently.
corrections.post_fix: Every added file needs a declared digest that matches its bytes. A one-byte mutation of lazy_read_api.py turns the verifier FAIL with 'added file no longer matches added_files_sha256'; restoring the exact bytes returns PASS. codegraph and zvec-grep gained the missing declarations.

corrections.pre_fix: The captured manifest id hashed the watcher observation sequence, so recursive fs.watch attach events on macOS produced a new identity for byte-identical sources and a clean workspace reported itself dirty.
corrections.post_fix: Identity covers workspace, scope, profile, file hashes and exclusions only; publication reconciles up to three watcher hints, marks only the generation its own sync captured, and stays dirty if hints persist.

corrections.proof: vendor/serena/src/serena/lazy_read_api.py with a nine-fixture line-model comparison
corrections.pre_fix: Pyright reported a synthetic File symbol ending at line 6 for a five-line file, so a cross-file references answer was demoted to incomplete evidence.
corrections.post_fix: The File range is derived from the owned bytes with the same line model the reader addresses (split on LF, packages/core/src/adapters/semantic.ts:145). LF, CRLF, lone CR, missing trailing newline, newline-only, empty, VT, FF and NEL fixtures all equal the snapshot's last addressable line; undecodable bytes drop the range instead of inventing one.

corrections.pre_fix: The gate counted a canonicalAnchor field that the public result never carried, so a correct answer was recorded as zero anchored evidence.
corrections.post_fix: It counts evidence whose anchor span is utf8-bytes with sourceCheck matched; the fresh run reports anchored=3.
